description:
BM25 full-text search over items (no body returned, token-light).

Ranked by weighted BM25 (SQLite FTS5) over the title, the original-language summary,
the English summary, sentence-free English search signals and — for items whose
license permits redistribution — the body.
Japanese text is morphologically segmented at index time, so Japanese queries match
words that a substring search would miss. Results carry score (0-1), rank and a
snippet of the matching passage. Use portal_get to read a matched item's body.

q.description: keyword(s). space-separated terms are ANDed. e.g. "openai gpt"
